name: RNA-Puzzles 3D Structure Prediction Benchmark
description: RNA-Puzzles is a community benchmark for predicting RNA 3D structures, where participants submit models for newly released RNA targets and are judged against experimental structures. It evaluates the ability of methods to reconstruct RNA folding and tertiary interactions.
evaluation_method: Predicted RNA structures are scored against experimental references using structural similarity measures such as RMSD and other RNA-specific comparison metrics.
notes: Typically evaluated on new RNA targets as they are released, making it more of a periodic blind prediction challenge than a fixed static dataset.
